name: Chatsworth International School
summary: IB World School with multiple campuses and a relatively approachable admissions culture.
body: Chatsworth offers IB programmes across campuses that historically include Orchard and east-side sites. It is often shortlisted by families seeking IB without the longest mega-school waitlists — though demand still varies by grade. Verify which campus matches your housing. Multi-campus / bus routing questions matter as much as fee bands when both adults work across town. Dual-career note: author-visit and book-parade weeks are hard calendar blocks, not optional drop-ins.
waitlistNotes: Often more flexible mid-year than mega-campuses — still apply early.
